about.title: About Azmera
about.description: Learn more about our platform and mission
about.page_description: Learn about our mission to transform Ethiopian agriculture
about.hero_description: A comprehensive digital platform connecting farmers, buyers, and service providers across Ethiopia's agricultural value chain.
about.problem1: Farmers lack direct market access and fair pricing
about.problem3: Limited access to modern farming techniques
about.problem4: Inefficient supply chains and high post-harvest losses
about.problem5: Difficulty accessing credit and financial services
about.solution_description: Azmera is a comprehensive digital platform that connects all stakeholders in Ethiopia's agricultural ecosystem, providing tools for fair trade, knowledge sharing, and efficient logistics.
about.feature_marketplace_desc: Direct connection between farmers and buyers
about.feature_ai_desc: Smart farming assistance powered by AI
about.feature_mobile_desc: Accessible on any device, optimized for mobile
about.key_pricing_desc: Get fair market prices powered by AI
about.key_matching_desc: Connect with the right buyers and sellers
about.key_escrow_desc: Secure payments for peace of mind
about.step1_desc: Create your account as farmer, buyer, or service provider
about.step2_desc: List your products or browse available items
about.step3_desc: Payment held in escrow for protection
about.step4_desc: Coordinate delivery through our logistics network
about.revenue_logistics_desc: Commission on delivery and storage services
about.business_model_note: Our model ensures sustainability while keeping costs low for farmers
about.phase1_desc: Partner with cooperatives in key regions
about.phase2_desc: Expand to additional regions and user segments
about.cta_description: Join thousands of farmers, buyers, and service providers already using Azmera to grow their agricultural business.
about.status_subtitle: Live metrics from the Azmera ecosystem
about.roadmap_subtitle: Our roadmap for the future of Ethiopian agriculture
about.roadmap_q1_desc: Native iOS and Android applications for offline access
about.roadmap_q3_desc: End-to-end supply chain tracking on blockchain
about.mission_desc: To democratize access to agricultural markets and technology for every Ethiopian farmer.
about.vision_desc: A thriving, connected, and prosperous agricultural sector that feeds the nation and the world.
